meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保留旧版设计品味，确保前端项目兼容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目依赖旧版设计品味技能的行为
copy.tagline_en: Preserve legacy design taste for frontend compatibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project depends on the exact behavior of the v1 design taste skill

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照预设的设计参数（如视觉差异度 8、动感强度 6、信息密度 4）生成前端代码，并遵循严格的样式规则，例如禁止使用 emoji、限制强调色数量、避免居中布局等。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成或修改前端界面（如 React/Next.js 页面、组件）时触发，尤其是涉及视觉设计、布局、动效或交互的场景。

say.text: 帮我设计一个产品展示页，使用 split-screen 布局。
say.note: Claude 会应用非居中布局规则，生成左右分屏的页面。

say.text: 给这个仪表盘添加骨架屏加载状态。
say.note: Claude 会生成匹配布局的骨架屏，而非通用转圈动画。

say.text: 用 Geist 字体和深玫瑰色强调色重写这个 Hero 区域。
say.note: Claude 会替换字体和颜色，并避免使用紫色/蓝色。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates frontend code following preset design parameters (DESIGN_VARIANCE=8, MOTION_INTENSITY=6, VISUAL_DENSITY=4) and strict style rules: no emojis, max 1 accent color, avoid centered layouts, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate or modify a frontend UI (e.g., React/Next.js pages, components), especially involving visual design, layout, motion, or interaction.

say_en.text: Design a product showcase page using a split-screen layout.
say_en.note: Claude applies non-centered layout rules and generates a left-right split page.

say_en.text: Add skeleton loading states to this dashboard.
say_en.note: Claude generates layout-matching skeletons instead of generic spinners.

say_en.text: Rewrite this Hero section using Geist font and deep rose accent color.
say_en.note: Claude replaces font and color, avoiding purple/blue tones.
